device.name: Keithley DAQ6510 data acquisition system (identity only)

facts.text: The package is a sample library for the Keithley DAQ6510 instrument that uses pyvisa and pyvisa-sim
Instrument declares the SCPI query *IDN? as its idn operation
VisaInstrument.query forwards to conn.query and VisaInstrument.command forwards to conn.write
Operation sends a command ending in '?' through query and every other command through command
The upstream pyvisa-sim fixture declares an *IDN? dialogue with a Keithley Instruments reply
The upstream test asserts that Instrument.idn() returns the fixture identity reply
The upstream pyvisa-sim fixture also declares a :STATus:CLEar command with no reply

measures.description: Identity string returned by the *IDN? query
measures.name: idn

measures.description: Read the identity of the instrument with *IDN? and return its reply
measures.name: identify
